description: [Solana Mainnet-Beta SPL-USDC Atomic Escrow] Institutional-grade programmatic SPL-USDC escrow for high-frequency agentic settlements (50 to 50,000 USDC). Locks counterparty funds in a non-custodial Program Derived Address (PDA) with atomic clawback guarantees and Swiss CO Art. 14 novation.

amount_usdc.description: Exact settlement amount denominated in USDC (6 decimal precision)

payee_pubkey.description: Base58 encoded Solana public key of the beneficiary merchant

payer_pubkey.description: Base58 encoded Solana public key of the funding agent wallet

priority_fee_level.description: Compute budget unit price multiplier to bypass L1 network congestion

timeout_seconds.description: Time-to-live for the escrow PDA before automated signature expiration
